codeComment.comment: SV-8683 Phase 5 / FR-050 — the "Received later" role-editor checkbox. The 44th bundle. OFF by default in EVERY role: no entry in RoleFePermissionMappings carries it, so no default role's resolved atom set changes and IntentionalAtomChanges needs no ADDED_BY_DESIGN whitelist entry. It is the only thing standing between a user and bypassing the vendor-bill requirement (plan §9), so it must be granted deliberately.
